cases.ac: AC-1: Arrow keys steer the snake; head hitting the wall ends the game; the snake never leaves the grid.
cases.oracle: In the node:vm sandbox seed the snake mid-grid heading right, inject a left-turn key, step and assert the head moved to the expected cell; steer into the wall and step until gameOver is true; assert the head cell never leaves [0,24) on either axis and the score stays 0.

cases.ac: AC-2: The head entering a body cell ends the game.
cases.oracle: Grow the snake so a U-turn hits its own body: step until gameOver is true with the collision cell inside the body; assert score only reflects food eaten (0 if none).

cases.ac: AC-3: Eating food grows the snake by one, adds 10 to the score, and respawns food on a free cell; the HUD reflects the score.
cases.oracle: Seed food at the immediate next cell of the head: step once and assert score === 10, snake length grew by 1, food respawned to a free cell (not on the snake), and the HUD fillText calls include SCORE 10.

cases.ac: AC-4: Game over shows the overlay; R restarts to the initial state; the high score persists in localStorage and is restored as HIGH on the next game.
cases.oracle: Drive to gameOver with score 30: assert localStorage[snake-high-score-v1] holds {high:30} (or higher after a second game); inject the restart key and assert the board, score and snake reset to the initial state while HIGH reads 30 from the restored value.

cases.ac: AC-1 (reversal rule): a key that would reverse the snake 180 degrees (opposite of the current heading) is ignored; the snake keeps its heading.
cases.oracle: In the node:vm sandbox seed the snake heading right with length >= 2: inject the left key (exact 180-degree reversal), step once, and assert the head advanced one cell to the RIGHT (reversal ignored, no self-collision triggered by direction flip); then inject up, step, and assert the turn took effect.

cleanup.environment: Stateless node --test run: the game script is loaded into a node:vm sandbox with stubbed DOM/canvas/localStorage per subtest; nothing to tear down.
cleanup.data: localStorage is an in-memory stub under key snake-high-score-v1; no disk fixtures, no live config touched.
